name: Google Sheets
description: Read a range from a spreadsheet, and add rows to it.
intentHints: put a report in a sheet
_authNote: OAuth endpoints, scopes, client secret ref and any identity step are PLATFORM-OWNED — they live in the private clarity-api (integrations-v2/config/oauth-configs.ts), never in this public repo. This manifest only declares that the integration uses oauth2 and which tools it provides.
_scopeNote: Connected on drive.file, which Google marks Recommended/Non-sensitive for the Sheets API. It is PER-FILE: nothing is readable until the person picks a spreadsheet through the Google Picker, and that is the trade for needing no verification.

providedTools.description: The tabs in a spreadsheet, with their ids and titles. Needed to turn a tab into an A1 range.
The cell values in an A1 range, for example 'Sheet1!A1:D200'.
Add rows after the last row with data. Cannot overwrite existing cells.
Replace the cells in an A1 range. This overwrites what is there.
